Rhea Gomez: Quick flag — TideBank onboarding: p95 tail at ~2.1s on their dedicated pool, token spend ~2x forecast. Renewal in ~28 days. Proposing proactive pilot: compact 8-bit swap + request routing for heavy tails. Need eng + SRE + enablement to approve a short canary.

Diego Morales: share dash + a trace?

Rhea Gomez: dash: https://redwood.app/d/tidebank/ops?panelId=tail
trace: `req=tbank-22 seq=1..640 p50=95ms p95=2.1s model=redwood/salesa-7b`

Diego Morales: idea 9: try salesa-7b-int8 + prefix caching for repeated prompts. Could cut token-cost ~~35% and reduce scheduler backlog.

Rhea Gomez: dropping canary config, cc @Priya for enablement window.

Diego Morales: ```{"selector": "customer_id == \"tidebank\" && sample_rate < 0.15","model": "redwood/salesa-7b-int8","pool": "dedicated-tidebank-us-west","prefix_cache": "enabled","max_concurrency": 60,"fallback": "redwood/salesa-7b"}```

Priya Nair: can run a 30-min enablement: 10m infra, 10m canary ops, 10m customer notes. Available Tue/Wed next week.

Kait O'Neill: please surface conservative and optimistic savings for renewal.

OpsBot: [alert] tidebank_prod_avg_seq_len +18% last 24h; created ticket CS-4412.

Rowan SRE: I can reserve a 1-GPU slot in dedicated-tidebank-us-west for 48h. Need IAM list and expected peak rps.

Rhea Gomez: peak ~280 rps, steady ~120. IAM: rhea@redwood, diego@redwood, priya@redwood. I'll draft a customer-facing note and renewal blurb once canary is scheduled.

Kait O'Neill: great. include SLO targets (p95 <1.2s) and rollback criteria. Thanks all :thumbsup:
